question: Who authored the book “School to Startup: Navigating the Path of Entrepreneurship”?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rohit Sinha**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **“School to Startup: Navigating the Path of Entrepreneurship”** is authored by **Rohit Sinha**, an individual who focuses on guiding aspiring entrepreneurs through the journey from academic life to starting their own ventures.
 
• The book provides a comprehensive guide for students and young professionals looking to transition from formal education to becoming successful entrepreneurs.
 
• It outlines the **challenges**, **opportunities**, and **strategies** required to build and manage a startup, making it a valuable resource for budding entrepreneurs.
 
• The book emphasizes the importance of **innovation, leadership, and business acumen**, which are essential skills for any entrepreneur.
 
• The practical insights provided in the book are based on real-world experiences and case studies, making it relatable and actionable for readers.
 
• **Rohit Sinha** is known for his expertise in **entrepreneurship** and for mentoring individuals to achieve their business goals. His book is a contribution to nurturing entrepreneurial talent in India.
 
• ***Hence, the correct answer is Rohit Sinha.***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **About the Book:**

 
 
• The book delves into the **entrepreneurial ecosystem**, covering topics like **starting a business, finding investors, creating a business plan, and overcoming failures**.
 
• It is aimed at **students, young professionals, and aspiring entrepreneurs** who wish to understand the nuances of entrepreneurship and make informed decisions.
 
 
 
• **Relevance of the Book:**
 
 
• The book is particularly relevant in today’s era, where **startups are growing rapidly**, and governments are encouraging entrepreneurship through initiatives like **Startup India**.
 
• It addresses the gap between **academic knowledge** and **practical application**, helping readers navigate the challenges of starting and scaling a business.
 
 
 
• **Characteristics of Other Options:**
 
 
• **Romila Thapar:** A renowned historian, primarily known for her work on Indian history. She has not authored books related to entrepreneurship.
 
• **Bipin Chandra:** A famous historian known for his books on modern Indian history. His works focus on freedom struggles and socio-political issues.
 
• **Shashi Tharoor:** A prominent politician, diplomat, and author, known for his works on Indian history, culture, and politics. He has not authored a book on entrepreneurship.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Key Highlights of “School to Startup”:**

 
 
• The book provides a **step-by-step guide** for young entrepreneurs, starting from identifying a business idea to executing it effectively.
 
• It discusses **real-life examples** and **case studies**, making it relatable and actionable.
 
• The book also emphasizes the importance of **resilience, adaptability, and continuous learning** in the entrepreneurial journey.
 
 
 
• **Encouragement for Young Entrepreneurs:**
 
 
• Books like these contribute to fostering an **entrepreneurial mindset** among the youth, which is vital for economic growth and innovation.
 
• It aligns with government initiatives like **Startup India** that aim to boost entrepreneurship and create job opportunities.
